title: JOYOR S5-ABE All-terrain Electric Scooter
sellingPoints: Maximum speed 20 km/h, legal to drive in Germany and Austria
10″ tires with front and rear disc brakes
Lightweight and foldable, easy to take into the subway

details.title: Simple and exquisite
details.content: Utilizing solid aluminum, the S5 ABE showcases outstanding thermal conductivity and corrosion resistance, ensuring longevity. Its sleek appearance design is paired with components and accessories that adhere to a unified geometric design language, emphasizing usability and user experience.

details.title: Easy to operate
details.content: High-definition LCD display, real-time display of riding information. Ergonomically designed one-piece handlebar, equipped with electric horn. Accurate deceleration with finger pressure throttle, multi-function keyboard to easily switch between different riding modes. Front, rear and turn signal control switches ensure riding safety.

details.title: 500W Powerful Motor
details.content: The S5 ABE e-scooter features a 500W brushless motor for swift acceleration and 20-degree hill climbing, reaching max speeds of 20 km/h on diverse terrains.

details.title: Long battery life
details.content: High-capacity 48V 13 AH rechargeable battery provides a long range of 30-45 km under certain conditions with a maximum load of 150kg. You can enjoy the freedom of long-distance riding

details.title: High-response disc brake system
details.content:
A front and rear dual disc brake system with ultra-high transmission efficiency ensures your braking is more timely,
less strenuous, and smoother.

details.title: Foldable and portable
details.content: The S5 ABE e-scooter has an unfolded size of 1215*610*1230mm and a folded size of 1120*610*525mm. It weighs 22.7kg and is easy to transport and store. It is an ideal choice for commuting to school, work or short trips.

moreDetails.caption: The scooter includes an LCD screen that displays details on speed, mode, battery, and lighting.
360-degree lighting improves visibility for safe driving in low light.
Front and rear disc brakes ensure consistent braking efficiency at high speeds
The Lift Riser is designed to provide ergonomic benefits for users working at a desk for extended periods.
